name: El Chaltén & Fitz Roy
about: Trekking season runs Oct–Apr; many of the town's restaurants and services close entirely in the deep winter (Jun–Aug). Fitz Roy is notoriously often clouded over, even in good weather.
overview: Argentina's self-declared trekking capital — free, well-marked trails to Fitz Roy and Cerro Torre, with Perito Moreno Glacier a few hours away near El Calafate.
costOverview: The trails themselves are free — no permits, no paid campsites required for day hikes — so this is genuinely more affordable than Torres del Paine if you're not paying for guided treks.
